messages:
sam: Kicking off a staged rollout for the precision-fallback patch (engine v2.4.1-quant). Canary at 1% first, will expand if checks pass.

deploybot: [deploy] triggered canary -> engine:v2.4.1-quant -> slice=1% -> canary_id=cb-3899012345

maya: Noted. I will watch NaN/error traces and memory growth. Enabling extra logging for matmul paths.

chris-l: Quick summary: patch adds an 8-bit fallback matmul when the CUDA fp16 kernel encounters divergent values. Goal is to avoid crashes on older drivers that produce NaNs. Need to validate no perf cliff for short-sequence chat loads.

yara: Release notes draft uploaded: https://go/release-notes/engine-v2.4.1-quant (please review wording around fallback semantics)

ops-oncall: Added a temporary alert: if tail latency p99 increases >12% vs baseline OR NaN errors >0.1% of requests in 5m, we escalate. Alert ID: infra-alert-8842.

maya: Smoke commands I'm running:
```
./smoke_run.sh --targets=all --seq=512 --batch=2 --check-kernels
# grep for NaN in logs:
grep "NaN" /var/log/engine/*.log || true
```

sam: Can we confirm rollback/pin policy? Proposal: auto-pin to previous stable kernel if error-rate >0.5% OR p95 latency regresses >20% sustained for 10m. Manual rollback if memory increase >1GB on average for 5m.

chris-l: Ack. I'll wire the canary actor to disable dynamic batching for the canary slice to isolate kernel perf impact. Also adding a short-run perf harness to compute token-per-second delta.

deploybot: [status] canary started at 3899012345, checks scheduled at +10m,+30m. Observability hooks: perf-harness, nan-detect, mem-heap-sample.

yara: Draft release-note blurb: "Adds conservative 8-bit matmul fallback for quantized kernels to mitigate rare NaN crashes on specific CUDA driver combinations. Fallback is gated by driver/version checks and can be pinned off per-customer." Link to commit: https://go/commit/cc12ab3

ops-oncall: Ops note: if we see memory bump >1GB, we do immediate traffic drain of canary and escalate to infra SRE. Also prepared a pre-approved rollback PR to pin engine to v2.4.0-quant (PR: https://go/pr/rollback-3899012345).

maya: Running smoke now, will post short logs in 6m. If you want raw traces: 
```
TRACE_EXPORT=1 ./collect_traces.sh cb-3899012345 > traces/cb-3899012345.json
```

sam: One last ask — dashboards: can we surface a small chart that compares canary vs baseline p50/p95/p99 and NaN counts per minute? Put it in the release dashboard and link in this thread.

chris-l: Done. Dashboard link: https://go/dashboards/engine/rollouts/3899012345. It has canary vs baseline panels and a NaN histogram.

maya: Smoke complete: no NaNs in 10k requests, mem delta +200MB, p95 regressed 6% (within threshold). I'll keep watch for the next 30m.

sam: OK. proceeding to expand to 10% in 30m if no regressions. Leave this thread open for telemetry comments. :thumbsup:
